blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) has stepped up monitoring of banks’ exposure to the agriculture sector amid the ongoing El Niño phenomenon, while keeping relief measures on standby for lenders hit hard by calamities.
